lr_activate_lr_at.description: Living prisoners at or below which LR turns on (1-32).

lr_time_base.description: Round time (seconds) to set when LR turns on; 0 leaves the clock alone.

lr_time_per_lr.description: Seconds added to the round per decided LR (capped by max_time_for_lr).

lr_time_per_guard.description: Seconds added per living guard when LR turns on.

max_time_for_lr.description: Maximum round time during LR (the per-LR bonus never goes past it).

lr_b4b_kill_by_health.description: Shot for shot / mag for mag: after 60s the player with less health dies.

lr_race_enabled.description: Offer the Race LR (off by default, as in the original plugin).

rebel_on.description: Allow the last prisoner to !rebel instead of taking an LR.

rebel_t_weapon.description: Weapon given to an LR rebel.

rebel_ct_max_hp.description: Max HP each living guard contributes to an LR rebel's health (1-1000).

rebel_t_hp_ratio.description: LR rebel health = pooled guard HP x this ratio.

rebel_t_max_hp.description: Cap on an LR rebel's health (1-1000).

lg_min_cts.description: Guards alive at round start needed for last guard to be possible (1-32).

lg_time_base.description: Round time to set when last guard starts; 0 disables last guard.

lg_time_per_prisoner.description: Seconds added per living prisoner when last guard starts.

lg_time_per_kill.description: Seconds added per prisoner killed during last guard.

lg_time_max.description: Maximum round time during last guard.

lg_ct_hp_ratio.description: Last guard health = pooled prisoner HP x this ratio.

lg_t_max_hp.description: Max HP each living prisoner contributes to the last guard's health (1-1000).

lg_max_hp.description: If the last guard keeps their own (higher) health, cap it at this.

lg_apply_lower_hp.description: Always set the last guard to the pooled health, even when lower.

lg_t_weapon.description: Weapon given to every prisoner when last guard starts (empty = none).
